source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Requester asks for a random complex scene that makes the newly reflected soil/earth subject visible and uses the supplied portrait. Soil/earth is resolved from the actual prior user context about soil terminology, not from local candidate data. The author independently sampled a future generation-ship nursery as a physically plausible fictional place with large scale. A small condensate failure erodes living loam; a keeper repairs the route and covers exposed roots, making human care legible through connected traces. The intended experience is intimate practical concentration against the scale of a ship carrying living earth. All era, role, hose, seedling, hand staging, clay repair, garment, camera, palette and material-test expectations are agent choices. Saved sensual 1 adds subtle warmth of face, parted lips and tactile clothing; fetish 0 adds no special erotic focus, surreal 0 keeps geometry and gravity plausible, creativity 1 develops a restrained repair moment within the user-authorized complex concept. The reference supplies observed face and hair only, not identity, biography or personality. The generic event anchor preserves the soil subject becoming visible; it does not promote the invented repair recipe to requester ownership.
subject: A fictional woman with face and hair guided by the supplied portrait, tending living earth.
setting: Working end of a vast physically plausible cylindrical soil nursery aboard a fictional future generation ship at destination sunrise.
event: Visible soil material in a connected authored scene; the independently chosen realization is repairing a runoff breach and restoring soil contact around roots.
visual_priorities: Face, both owned hands and the small working area form one readable foreground relationship.
A loose hose feeds the eroded rill; the clay ridge directs its water into the drainage channel and a sediment fan records that route.
Discrete dark loam crumbs supporting roots contrast with cohesive ochre clay and finer pale washed sediment.
A small human repair is set against long planted beds and ribbed architecture, with sunrise secondary.
baseline_prompt_en: Photograph a complex soil-centered scene at the working end of a long cylindrical nursery aboard a future generation ship, just as the first distant sunrise reaches its forward observation window. A human subject guided by the supplied portrait's face and hair is tending a damaged planting bed. Her rounded oval face, large dark eyes, small softly rounded nose and pink lips retain the reference's appearance; her chin-length dark brown bob curves inward, with fine wispy bangs across her forehead. Her face is turned in a readable three-quarter view as she studies the water beside her hands, lips slightly parted and warm light across one cheek. A fitted sage sleeveless knit top and practical charcoal trousers give her a quiet, tactile human presence within the cool industrial space. The soil itself carries the visible event. A loose condensate hose at the far edge of the bed is discharging a thin stream into a newly eroded shallow rill. Its water has drawn fine pale sediment away from dark brown, crumbly loam and exposed a few roots of one small seedling. The woman kneels on the firm maintenance walkway beside the waist-wide bed, both knees supported, leaning only as far as her elbows can comfortably reach. Her right fingertips press a low ridge of wet ochre clay into the short breach between the damaged rill and the normal drainage channel. The clay holds smooth finger impressions and a coherent rounded edge; water curls around that edge and flows into the channel. Her left palm cups loose loam against the seedling's rootball beside the ridge, leaving distinct small earthy crumbs caught between roots and fingers. The redirected water leaves a shallow pale sediment fan immediately downstream. Moist intact soil around the plant, fresh clay hand marks, the washed groove and the sediment fan remain visibly connected across this one small working area. Show her head, torso, knees, both hands and the near soil edge in a landscape environmental photograph from the adjoining walkway. Keep her face and the material contacts readable in the same focal zone. The repeating ribs and successive planted beds recede far down the immense cylindrical chamber; the forward window carries a restrained sliver of orange sunrise above a planet's curved horizon. Soft practical nursery light and the distant warm beam separate dark loam, ochre cohesive clay, pale sediment and natural skin. Use restrained documentary color, plausible gravity and fine photographic surface detail.
